pack_id: P5-DUSKMOURN-ORIGIN — Before the Ascension, Marina and the House

dsk_guide.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Duskmourn
dsk_guide.perspective: Wizards of the Coast (official Magic Story)

entities.name: Forgotten original name of Duskmourn's plane
Lost magically and technologically sophisticated Duskmourn civilization
Three pre-Ascension realms (material, demonic and spirit)
Marina's illusory restoration of normal life
Five changing House zones of Duskmourn

claims.subject: duskmourn
claims.source_excerpt: Even the plane's original name has been forgotten
claims.summary: The original name of the plane that became Duskmourn is no longer known in the 2024 guide.
claims.limitation: The guide does not furnish the missing name or prove no future story could recover it.

claims.subject: duskmourn
claims.source_excerpt: hint at a plane both magically and technologically advanced
claims.summary: Surviving artifacts imply the original plane had substantial magical and technical knowledge.
claims.limitation: The guide explicitly uses 'hint', so a complete history of that civilization is not confirmed.

claims.subject: duskmourn
claims.source_excerpt: there used to be at least three separate realms of existence
claims.summary: Before the Ascension, the plane held at least material, demonic and spirit realms.
claims.limitation: At least three does not imply exactly three, nor does it fully explain their cosmology.

claims.subject: marina_vendrell
claims.source_excerpt: she discovered a small, strange entity living in the basement
claims.summary: Marina found an entity in the House's basement and initially considered it a friend.
claims.limitation: This early meeting is not the demon's summoning or the full escape of his binding.

claims.subject: marina_vendrell
claims.source_excerpt: she lured her bullies to her house and took them down to the basement
claims.summary: Marina brought her bullies into the basement after Valgavoth offered revenge.
claims.limitation: This documents the original encounter; it does not assign conscious responsibility for the later plane-wide Ascension to a child.

claims.subject: the_house
claims.source_excerpt: The neighborhood began to warp as well, twisting and growing strange and terrifying
claims.summary: The House's expanding influence warped nearby neighborhoods before consuming the plane.
claims.limitation: The guide gives no exact area, duration or in-world calendar year for this expansion.

claims.subject: valgavoth
claims.source_excerpt: he restored her perception of the world, encasing her in a bubble of warped unreality
claims.summary: Valgavoth preserved Marina's perception of normality while the House continued its expansion.
claims.limitation: The guide explicitly leaves Marina's level of awareness uncertain.

claims.subject: duskmourn
claims.source_excerpt: The House can be loosely categorized into five zones
claims.summary: The House's shifting geography is described through five overlapping zones.
claims.limitation: These are loose categories, not physically fixed or exhaustive barriers.

claims.subject: valgavoth
claims.source_excerpt: Previously, Valgavoth was able to temporarily force open doors to other planes
claims.summary: Before widespread Omenpaths, Valgavoth sometimes opened doors to lure victims from other planes.
claims.limitation: Previously is relative to the 2024 guide's story frame; these are not confirmed current transport capabilities after later events.

claims.subject: valgavoth
claims.source_excerpt: Harrowings occur whenever Valgavoth molts out of his latest form
claims.summary: Valgavoth's molting is followed by Harrowings that make the House more dangerous.
claims.limitation: The 2024 guide does not count every molt or guarantee future cycle timing.

claims.subject: dsk_quiescences
claims.source_excerpt: Quiescences, which occur right before Valgavoth molts
claims.summary: Quiescences precede Valgavoth's molts and the associated Harrowings.
claims.limitation: This order describes the recurring local cycle, not a timestamp in the Multiverse chronology.

claims.subject: duskmourn
claims.source_excerpt: The location of the Below is the only fixed point in the whole of Duskmourn
claims.summary: The Below is described as the only fixed point amid the House's changing geography.
claims.limitation: Rumors of an exit in the Below are not verified by the guide and are not asserted here.

remaining: The original plane's name remains unknown and ancient civilization evidence is suggestive rather than complete.
The guide's 2024 timeframe cannot verify present-day exits, rulers, or later outcomes without newer primary sources.
Preserve the separate first-three Duskmourn claims: this pack supplements, does not duplicate, Valgavoth's binding and the Ascension.
No lore decks or approvals before foundation certification.
